window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; several items describe operations from late October or early November, with dates stated in each story. No new SOUTHCOM strike announcements could be verified; the most recent tally found (USNI News, 5 October) put deaths at 238.

stories.headline: Border Patrol checkpoint in San Clemente yields over 1,400 pounds of cocaine from two back-to-back vehicle stops
stories.body: Agents at the San Clemente checkpoint in California's San Diego Sector stopped two vehicles on 25 October and found about 550 vacuum-sealed packages of suspected cocaine, valued at roughly $9.8 million. Both drivers were arrested and the DEA took custody of them and the drugs; the case was publicized on 7 November.

stories.headline: Coast Guard cutter William Trump brings ashore about 3,600 pounds of cocaine from two Caribbean interdictions
stories.body: The cutter's crew landed the haul on Wednesday 4 November, with the drugs valued near $27 million. Four detainees were handed to federal agents at Port Everglades, Florida.

stories.headline: Mexican Navy seizes 1.1 tonnes of cocaine in two Pacific operations off Chiapas and Oaxaca
stories.body: Security secretary Omar García Harfuch announced on 5 November that the navy recovered 1,149 kg of suspected cocaine in two at-sea operations; one person was arrested in the second and passed to federal prosecutors. The navy did not say when the operations took place.
